priority_policy: partition the x-then-y sorted 40 class points by order-five residue; visit nonempty residues in ascending residue number round-robin, with ascending point index within each residue
relation_policy: base degree-2/5 rows plus direct support<=4 rows; enumerate signed Hecke outside-trace cancellations at support<=4; stop first rational rank 40 or after 40 sources

selection.order_rule: 5 divides #E(Fp), 5 does not divide p-1, largest prime divisor of #E(Fp) >=53
